sb_prompt: DISCUSS PLANNING A FAMILY REUNION.  DRAW ON YOUR EXPERIENCES AND THOSE OF THE OTHER CALLER FOR MAKING THE NEXT GET-TOGETHER SUCCESSFUL AND MEMORABLE.
turns: Yeah, I'm actually calling about family reunions because last year my mom made a huge deal about it and it turned into a total mess with everyone arriving at different times.
Oh wow, that sounds horrible, my cousin's wife almost skipped the last one because she didn't know where to park!
Yeah, exactly! She made us all meet at the grocery store so everyone could just walk in together.
Yeah, but honestly I think a grocery store is just a terrible idea for a big family get-together.
I mean, you gotta have a real place for people to sit and eat together, you can't just park cars in the parking lot and call it a reunion.
You know what? Yeah, I can see why, but I gotta be honest, we usually just grab a cheap takeout or something at the pool.
Takeout? Come on, that's not even a reunion, that's just us eating in our cars while we wait!
Well, it's better than trying to coordinate forty people eating off a picnic table at the park, that's just too much work.
Yeah, besides, last time my aunt came over, my little niece tried to eat her turkey sandwich and accidentally fed half of it to the dog!
Oh man, that is the worst thing that could happen, we'd have to clean up the whole yard.
Yeah, imagine trying to carry a whole turkey through the neighborhood, plus everyone else's stuff and the dog just running wild.
Yeah, I can picture the dog stealing the whole thing while we're trying to find our seats.
I mean, one less turkey to feed the dog sounds like a huge relief to me.
Yeah, honestly I think if we just eat at a restaurant it's way less stressful for everyone.
Yeah, but then you gotta spend your whole reunion arguing about who's paying the bill!
Yeah, but restaurants are so expensive we might as well just stay home and order pizza.
Pizza sounds good, but can we at least make sure we don't end up splitting it fifty ways like last time?
Yeah, but then someone always forgets their half and just eats the other person's slice.
That's the worst, I can't believe someone would eat my slice!
I guess I can try to keep everyone's food separate if we order a few big pans instead of individual slices.
That sounds way smarter, plus you can just put it in a big bowl and nobody can steal a single slice.
Yeah, that's a great idea, maybe we can just divide up the big bowls so nobody can sneak a second serving!
Yeah, that's exactly how we'd do it, we'd just bring the big bowls and nobody can sneak anything!
Yeah, that would definitely keep the chaos down to a minimum.
Yeah, that's probably the best way to avoid any fighting over the food.
Yeah, that sounds like a solid plan, so what do you usually suggest for the next one?
We could just meet at my mom's house and I'll bring the food and you bring the dessert.
Dessert sounds perfect, I'll make those chocolate chip cookies and bring a big batch so we don't have to worry about running out.
Oh, chocolate chip cookies are a lifesaver, that's so much better than trying to bake a whole pie that might fall apart.
Yeah, I'll pack 'em in a big Tupperware so no one can sneak a bite before the ceremony!
Yeah, that sounds like a solid plan.
Yeah, that sounds fair, I'll get the cookies baked and wrapped up this weekend.
Yeah, I'll just bring a big pot of chili and we can just dig right in!
Yeah, chili sounds perfect, just bring the big pot and we'll just dig right in!
Yeah, just bring the pot and we can just dig right in!
That sounds awesome, just bring the pot and we can just dig right in!
Yeah, just bring the pot and we'll just dig right in!
